combat.overheat: Overheating! Spend Heat to cool down

hydraulic_strike.name: Hydraulic Strike
hydraulic_strike.desc: Swing your hydraulic fist in a wide arc. Above 70 Heat, sets enemies on fire.

seismic_shock.name: Seismic Shock
seismic_shock.desc: Slam the ground, knocking enemies back and making them Vulnerable.

rocket_leap.name: Rocket Leap
rocket_leap.desc: Boost into the air and crash down, stunning enemies where you land.

energy_shield.name: Energy Shield
energy_shield.desc: Project a barrier worth 35% of your life and shake off stuns and slows.

piston_jab.name: Piston Jab
piston_jab.desc: A fast, narrow jab that briefly makes enemies Vulnerable. Generates Heat.

furnace_cleave.name: Furnace Cleave
furnace_cleave.desc: A wide superheated cleave that sets enemies on fire.

coolant_flush.name: Coolant Flush
coolant_flush.desc: Vent 40 Heat into coolant: heal 18% of your life and gain a small barrier.

magnetic_pull.name: Magnetic Pull
magnetic_pull.desc: A magnetic burst that drags nearby enemies to you and stuns them briefly.

heat_vent.name: Heat Vent
heat_vent.desc: Release all stored Heat as a wave of fire. The more Heat, the more damage (requires 20 Heat).

orbital_strike.name: Orbital Strike
orbital_strike.desc: Call down an orbital strike {aim}. After a short warning it deals massive damage, stuns and makes enemies Vulnerable.

vibro_slash.name: Vibro Slash
vibro_slash.desc: A wide vibroblade slash that makes enemies Vulnerable. Generates Focus.

piercing_shot.name: Piercing Shot
piercing_shot.desc: A heavy round that passes through every enemy in a line.

pistol_barrage.name: Pistol Barrage
pistol_barrage.desc: Fire a fan of five pistol rounds. Devastating up close.

holo_decoy.name: Holo Decoy
holo_decoy.desc: Project a hologram that enemies nearby attack instead of you.

smoke_cloak.name: Smoke Cloak
smoke_cloak.desc: Vanish in smoke for 4 seconds: enemies lose track of you and your next hit is a guaranteed critical strike. Heals 10% of your life and removes stuns and slows.

minefield.name: Minefield
minefield.desc: Throw three mines that arm after a moment and explode when enemies step close, stunning them.

cluster_grenade.name: Cluster Grenade
cluster_grenade.desc: Throw a grenade that explodes, sets enemies on fire and scatters bomblets.

death_mark.name: Death Mark
death_mark.desc: Mark every enemy in a wide area for 10 seconds. Marked enemies take 25% more damage and refund 15 Focus when they die.

spore_dart.name: Spore Dart
spore_dart.desc: Fire a poisoned spore dart. Generates Biomass.

scalpel_slash.name: Scalpel Slash
scalpel_slash.desc: A quick scalpel slash that heals you for 8% of the damage dealt. Generates Biomass.

spore_burst.name: Spore Burst
spore_burst.desc: Release a cloud of spores {aim} that poisons enemies inside it for 5 seconds.

parasite_link.name: Parasite Link
parasite_link.desc: Latch onto the enemy {aimNearest} for 3 seconds, draining its life and healing you for 25% of the damage.

chitin_armor.name: Chitin Armor
chitin_armor.desc: Harden your skin for 6 seconds: take 30% less damage, and melee attackers are hurt.

spore_cocoon.name: Spore Cocoon
spore_cocoon.desc: Wrap yourself in a fungal cocoon: a barrier of 25% of your life, heal 10% and remove stuns and slows.

raise_corpse.name: Raise Corpse
raise_corpse.desc: Raise up to 2 corpses {aimNear} as minions that fight for you (up to 6). Needs corpses.

grasping_tendrils.name: Grasping Tendrils
grasping_tendrils.desc: Tendrils burst from the ground {aim}, holding enemies in place for 2 seconds and poisoning them.

corpse_explosion.name: Corpse Explosion
corpse_explosion.desc: Detonate up to 3 corpses {aimNear} in toxic blasts. Needs corpses.

wrath_of_lumen.name: Wrath of Lumen
wrath_of_lumen.desc: A colossal Lumen creature erupts {aim} for 12 seconds. It draws enemies to itself and slams everything around it.

censer_strike.name: Censer Strike
censer_strike.desc: Swing the censer in a wide arc. Corrupted enemies take 25% more damage. Generates Devotion.

holy_light.name: Holy Light
holy_light.desc: Fire a seeking mote of light. Corrupted enemies take 50% more damage. Generates Devotion.

heal.name: Heal
heal.desc: Heal yourself and allies nearby for 15% of their life. The same light burns corrupted enemies around you.

magnus_exorcismus.name: Magnus Exorcismus
magnus_exorcismus.desc: Inscribe a holy sigil {aim} that strikes everything inside 6 times over 5 seconds. Corrupted enemies take 80% more damage.

kyrie_eleison.name: Kyrie Eleison
kyrie_eleison.desc: Shield yourself and allies nearby with a barrier of 25% of their life for 6 seconds. Generates Devotion.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.desc: Consecrate the ground at your feet for 7 seconds. Allies in it recover 4% life every second; enemies are burned, corrupted ones twice as hard.

blessing.name: Blessing
blessing.desc: Bless yourself and allies nearby for 10 seconds: 20% more damage, 12% faster moves and casts. Removes stuns and slows. Generates Devotion.

lex_aeterna.name: Lex Aeterna
lex_aeterna.desc: Judge the enemies {aimNear}: the next hit each of them takes deals double damage.

guardian_light.name: Guardian Light
guardian_light.desc: Summon a light that follows you for 25 seconds (up to 2). It shoots enemies and mends allies near it.

benediction.name: Benediction
benediction.desc: A pillar of light heals allies nearby for 30% of their life and keeps them from dying for 8 seconds. Enemies are struck and stunned.

named.warden: The Warden of the Mother Tree

enemies.warden: The Warden of the Mother Tree
enemies.regrowing: It is regrowing from its fungi — destroy them!

ostrow.name: Ostrow, Absorbed
ostrow.line: You hung four lamps by the lift. Where is mine?

lenn.name: Brother Lenn, Absorbed
lenn.line: I sang so I would not hear them. Now I am the song.

halvorsen.name: Dr. Halvorsen, Absorbed
halvorsen.line: I can hear the roots under your feet. They are singing.

rhee.name: Rhee, Absorbed
rhee.line: I built these for you. Please do not run.

danner.name: Pvt. Danner, Absorbed
danner.line: I told you I was not one of them. Not yet.

statusDesc.stealth: Hidden from enemies. The next attack hits harder.
statusDesc.evasive: Briefly harder to hit after a dodge.
statusDesc.chitin: Takes 30% less damage and reflects some back.
statusDesc.empowered: Deals more damage and moves faster.
statusDesc.blessed: Deals 20% more damage and acts 12% faster.
statusDesc.lexAeterna: The next hit deals double damage.
statusDesc.benediction: Takes 20% less damage and survives one killing blow.

statInfo.strength: If Strength is your class's main attribute, each point adds 0.1% damage. Otherwise each point adds 0.5 Armor.
statInfo.dexterity: Each point adds 0.02% critical strike chance. If it is your class's main attribute, each point also adds 0.1% damage.
statInfo.intelligence: Each point adds 0.05% to all resistances. If it is your class's main attribute, each point also adds 0.1% damage.
statInfo.willpower: Each point adds 0.1% resource generation. If it is your class's main attribute, each point also adds 0.1% damage.
statInfo.damage: Your estimated damage per hit with every bonus counted. Use it to compare gear and builds.
statInfo.weaponDamage: The base damage of your equipped weapon. Every skill multiplies this number.
statInfo.critChance: The chance that a hit is a critical strike. Raised by Dexterity, gear and passives. Capped at 80%.
statInfo.critDamage: How much extra damage a critical strike deals on top of a normal hit.
statInfo.attackSpeed: How much faster you attack and cast basic skills. Raised by gear and passives.
statInfo.bonus: A damage bonus that adds to your other damage bonuses. Comes from gear, passives and temporary effects.
statInfo.maxLife: How much damage you can take before you die. Raised by level, gear and passives.
statInfo.armor: Reduces physical damage you take. Stronger attackers get through the same Armor more easily.
statInfo.armorReduction: The share of physical damage your Armor stops from an enemy of your level.
statInfo.resist: Reduces damage of this type that you take. Raised by Intelligence, gear and passives. Capped at 70%.
statInfo.damageReduction: A share of all damage you take that is ignored. Capped at 50%.
statInfo.cooldownReduction: Makes your skill cooldowns shorter. Capped at 50%.
statInfo.resourceGen: Makes your class resource build up faster.
statInfo.moveSpeed: How much faster you run than your base speed. Capped at 50%.
statInfo.barrierBonus: Makes the barriers you create absorb more damage.
statInfo.potionHealing: How much more life a stim pack restores.
statInfo.lifeOnKill: Life you recover every time you kill an enemy.

scalpel_slash.desc: Scalpel Slash heals for 4% more of its damage.

raise_corpse.name: Enhanced Raising
raise_corpse.desc: You can have one more minion.

searing.name: Searing Strike

crushing.name: Crushing Strike
crushing.desc: Hydraulic Strike deals +40% damage to Stunned and to Vulnerable enemies.

breaching.desc: Piston Jab deals x50% damage to Vulnerable enemies.

pull.name: Seismic Pull
pull.desc: Seismic Shock pulls enemies in instead of pushing them away.

rupture.name: Rupture
rupture.desc: Seismic Shock leaves a burning fissure for 3 seconds.

wildfire.name: Wildfire
wildfire.desc: Furnace Cleave deals +50% damage to Burning enemies.

molten.name: Molten Whirl
molten.desc: Furnace Cleave hits all around you, but deals 15% less damage.

reactive.name: Reactive Plating
reactive.desc: While you have a barrier, deal +15% damage.

restoring.name: Restoring Field
restoring.desc: Energy Shield also heals 12% of your life.

crater.name: Impact Crater
crater.desc: Rocket Leap leaves a burning crater for 4 seconds.

polarity.name: Polarity
polarity.desc: Magnetic Pull makes enemies Vulnerable for 3 seconds.

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.desc: Vibro Slash winds up 30% faster and deals +20% damage to Vulnerable enemies.

deadshot.name: Deadshot
deadshot.desc: Piercing Shot deals +50% damage to Elites and +25% to Marked enemies.

explosive.name: Explosive Round
explosive.desc: Piercing Shot explodes on the first enemy it hits instead of piercing, dealing 10% more damage in an area.

incendiary.name: Incendiary Rounds
incendiary.desc: Pistol Barrage sets enemies on fire.

volatile.name: Volatile Hologram
volatile.desc: Holo Decoy explodes when it ends or is destroyed.

hardlight.name: Hardlight
hardlight.desc: Holo Decoy has twice the life and taunts from 50% farther away.

ambush.name: Ambush
ambush.desc: Your attacks from stealth deal x60% damage.

regroup.name: Regroup
regroup.desc: Smoke Cloak heals 15% more of your life.

vanish.name: Vanish
vanish.desc: Phase Shift makes you stealthed for 1.5 seconds.

shrapnel.name: Shrapnel
shrapnel.desc: Mines make enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

napalm.name: Napalm
napalm.desc: Cluster Grenade leaves burning ground for 4 seconds.

kill_order.name: Kill Order
kill_order.desc: Death Mark deals triple damage, and you deal x10% damage to Marked enemies.

virulent.name: Virulent Dart
virulent.desc: Spore Dart applies a second poison stack.

splitting.name: Splitting Dart
splitting.desc: Spore Dart fires three darts in a spread, each dealing 35% less damage.

butcher.name: Butcher
butcher.desc: Scalpel Slash deals +40% damage to Poisoned enemies.

caustic.name: Caustic Spores
caustic.desc: Spore Burst poisons 30% harder and makes enemies Vulnerable on impact.

hydra.name: Hydra
hydra.desc: Parasite Link latches onto 2 more enemies.

leech.name: Leech
leech.desc: Parasite Link heals for twice as much.

carapace.name: Carapace
carapace.desc: Chitin Armor also grants a barrier of 15% of your life.

regenerative.name: Regenerative Chitin
regenerative.desc: Chitin Armor heals 15% of your life.

spore_shell.name: Spore Shell
spore_shell.desc: Spore Cocoon releases a poison cloud around you.

horde.name: Horde
horde.desc: Two more minions, and each cast raises one more corpse.

ravenous.name: Ravenous Dead
ravenous.desc: Minions deal 40% more damage and have 40% more life.

withering.name: Withering Grip
withering.desc: Grasping Tendrils makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

plague_bomb.name: Plague Bomb
plague_bomb.desc: Each detonated corpse leaves a poison cloud.

colossus.name: Colossus
colossus.desc: Wrath of Lumen has twice the life and taunts from 50% farther away.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.desc: Wrath of Lumen slams 35% more often.

sweeping.name: Sweeping Censer
sweeping.desc: Censer Strike hits a 200 degree arc and reaches 0.5 m farther, but deals 10% less damage.

sundering.name: Sundering Censer
sundering.desc: Censer Strike makes enemies Vulnerable for 3 seconds.

twin_motes.name: Twin Motes
twin_motes.desc: Holy Light fires two motes in a spread, each dealing 30% less damage.

radiant_mote.name: Radiant Mote
radiant_mote.desc: Holy Light bursts on impact, hitting everything nearby, but deals 15% less damage.

mending.name: Deep Mending
mending.desc: Heal restores 23% of life instead of 15%.

smiting.name: Smiting Light
smiting.desc: Heal deals 60% more damage to corrupted enemies and costs 5 less Devotion.

rapid.name: Rapid Sigil
rapid.desc: Magnus Exorcismus strikes with 30% shorter pauses.

sanctified.name: Sanctified Ward
sanctified.desc: Kyrie Eleison also blesses allies for 5 seconds.

far_reaching.name: Far-Reaching Blessing
far_reaching.desc: Blessing reaches 40% farther and generates 10 more Devotion.

warding.name: Warding Blessing
warding.desc: Blessing also grants a barrier of 10% of life for 5 seconds.

judgment.name: Harsh Judgment
judgment.desc: Lex Aeterna deals twice as much damage on cast.

miracle.name: Miracle
miracle.desc: Benediction heals 50% of life instead of 30% and reaches 25% farther.

afterglow.name: Afterglow
afterglow.desc: Benediction also blesses allies for 10 seconds, and its cooldown is 20% shorter.

crushing_force.name: Crushing Force
crushing_force.desc: +6% damage to Vulnerable enemies per rank.

heat_tolerance.name: Heat Tolerance
heat_tolerance.desc: You can stay at max Heat 0.5 seconds longer before overheating, per rank.

exploit_weakness.name: Exploit Weakness
exploit_weakness.desc: +6% damage to Vulnerable enemies per rank.

toxicology.name: Toxicology
toxicology.desc: +6% damage to Poisoned enemies per rank.

hive_link.name: Hive Link
hive_link.desc: Your minions deal +5% damage per rank.

reactor_core.name: Reactor Core
reactor_core.desc: While Heat is at least 70%, deal x25% damage. You overheat 0.5 seconds sooner.

bulwark_protocol.name: Bulwark Protocol
bulwark_protocol.desc: While you have a barrier, deal x20% damage. Barriers are 30% stronger.

shockwave_engine.name: Shockwave Engine
shockwave_engine.desc: Vulnerable enemies take x30% damage from you.

deadeye.name: Deadeye
deadeye.desc: +10% critical strike chance, and your ranged attacks deal x20% damage.

saboteur.name: Saboteur
saboteur.desc: Minefield and Cluster Grenade deal x40% damage. +10% cooldown reduction.

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.desc: For 2.5 seconds after a dodge or Phase Shift you deal x35% damage. +8% movement speed.

hive_mind.name: Hive Mind
hive_mind.desc: Your minions deal x40% damage, and you can have 2 more.

pandemic.name: Pandemic
pandemic.desc: Deal x30% damage to Poisoned enemies. Spore Burst lasts 50% longer.

symbiote.name: Symbiote
symbiote.desc: Your melee attacks deal x25% damage, Scalpel Slash heals for 6% more, and you take 10% less damage.

devout.name: Devout
devout.desc: Heal, Sanctuary and Kyrie Eleison are 35% stronger, and Devotion builds 15% faster.

zealot.name: Zealot
zealot.desc: Your ranged attacks deal x15% damage, and x25% more to corrupted enemies. Magnus Exorcismus strikes with 20% shorter pauses and Lex Aeterna's cooldown is 25% shorter.

shepherd.name: Shepherd
shepherd.desc: You can have one more Guardian Light, with 40% more life, 25% longer life and 15% faster shots. Blessing reaches 20% farther, and you take 5% less damage.

governors_crucible.name: Governor's Crucible
governors_crucible.effect: Seismic Shock costs no Heat, but has a 3.5 second cooldown.
governors_crucible.flavor: The governor wore it to the very end. It held. He didn't.

ashwalker_treads.name: Ashwalker Treads
ashwalker_treads.effect: Rocket Leap cooldown −60% and landing damage +60%, but it costs 25 Heat and generates none.

fist_of_kharos.name: Fist of Kharos
fist_of_kharos.effect: Hydraulic Strike becomes a full spin that hits all around you, with 20% less damage.
fist_of_kharos.flavor: Forged from the first drill bit that touched the Lumen.

heart_of_lumen.name: Heart of Lumen
heart_of_lumen.effect: Deal x35% damage. Overheating no longer damages you.
heart_of_lumen.flavor: It beats. It is not yours.

widowmaker.name: Widowmaker
widowmaker.effect: Piercing Shot explodes on every enemy it passes through, but deals 30% less damage.
widowmaker.flavor: Every bullet has a name. This one has a list.

echo_holsters.name: Echo Holsters
echo_holsters.effect: Quick Shot fires three rounds in a spread, each dealing 40% less damage.

mother_of_spores.name: Mother of Spores
mother_of_spores.effect: Spore Dart bursts on impact, poisoning everything nearby and leaving a small spore cloud, but deals 20% less damage.

crown_of_the_hive.name: Crown of the Hive
crown_of_the_hive.effect: You can have 3 more minions and Raise Corpse raises one more, but minions have 30% less life.

dawnbringer.name: Dawnbringer
dawnbringer.effect: Holy Light bursts on impact, burning everything nearby and leaving a patch of burning ground, but deals 20% less damage.
dawnbringer.flavor: The first sunrise after the ash. He carries it still.

halo_of_the_penitent.name: Halo of the Penitent
halo_of_the_penitent.effect: Sanctuary lasts twice as long and covers 40% more area, but its cooldown is 50% longer.
halo_of_the_penitent.flavor: Worn heavy, so the sinner remembers.

ashen_heartwood.name: Ashen Heartwood
ashen_heartwood.effect: +8% damage. The Mother Tree burned, and some of its fire stayed with you.
ashen_heartwood.flavor: Charred all the way through. It is still warm, and it still beats.

seed_of_accord.name: Seed of Accord
seed_of_accord.effect: 6% less damage taken. The Vaults remember who spared them.
seed_of_accord.flavor: It fell into your open hand. Not dropped. Given.

select.title: Choose your character
select.corrupt: Damaged save – create a new character

bastion.tagline: Heavy melee in a battered exoskeleton
bastion.desc: A former security marine who stands in the middle of the fight. Bastion builds Heat by hitting and being hit, and spends it on crushing blows — but stay at max Heat too long and the suit overheats.

spectre.desc: A sniper and saboteur who fights with mobility, precision and traps. Focus refills on its own, and faster on critical hits and dodged attacks. Rifles, twin pistols and vibroblades.

xenomant.desc: A former biologist infected with Lumen who can command it. Biomass gathered from the dead raises servants and spreads spores. Forbidden power, with a price.

lightbearer.tagline: Colony chaplain who kept the lanterns lit
lightbearer.desc: A chaplain who carried the old light through the dark. Devotion grows as he mends and shields his allies, and pays for blessings, sigils and a guardian light. The same light burns the corrupted. Maces and sun staves.

interact.notBuilt: Sealed. Whatever waits behind this has not woken yet.
