ash.title: Memory: the evacuation that never came
ash.body: Lumen remembers the Flats as a place where people waited. It has kept the waiting and lost the reason: the lander hatches still read 'DAY 3', and the shuttle is always one hour away.

refinery.title: Memory: the furnace that would not go out
refinery.body: The Smelters fed the fire because the fire fed them. Lumen remembers the warmth, not the cost. Every shade here keeps stoking something that went cold years ago.

vault.title: Memory: the garden under glass
vault.body: Okafor's seeds are all here, perfectly labelled, perfectly alive. Lumen could not bear to let anything in the Vaults die, and so nothing in the Vaults was ever allowed to finish living.

0.title: Escape pod flight recorder
0.body: Pod 3 of the Halcyon relay. Distress call received from Kharos IV, Governor's seal attached. Atmospheric entry nominal. Correction: entry not nominal. Debris field over the landing zone. Brace. Brace. Brace.

1.title: Scrawled on a lander hatch
1.body: WE WAITED THREE DAYS FOR THE EVAC SHUTTLE. IT NEVER CAME. GONE EAST TO THE FUEL STATION. IF YOU CAN READ THIS, DON'T DRINK THE WATER FROM THE CRATERS. – T.

2.title: Dr. Ines Okafor – personal log 1
2.body: The crystals in the deep core samples aren't inert. Under the scope they move, slowly, toward heat. I filed a report with the Governor's office. They thanked me for my diligence and asked me to keep the samples sealed.

3.title: Convoy driver's data pad
3.body: Route 7 is closed at the checkpoint. Soldiers say there's a quarantine. Nobody says what for. We've been idling for nine hours and the ash is getting into the filters. Marta keeps coughing. She says it's just the ash.

4.title: Outpost Ember notice board
4.body: RULES OF EMBER: 1. Nobody sleeps outside the ring. 2. Anyone with green in their eyes leaves. No arguments. 3. The cook decides the rations. 4. Keep the generator running. The light keeps them away. Mostly.

5.title: Dr. Ines Okafor – personal log 2
5.body: Second report ignored. Three drill crew from Shaft 9 are in the infirmary with a fever and green veins under their fingernails. The Governor says the drills keep running. Quotas from the Consortium. I said people will die. He said people already are.

6.title: Mining foreman's audio log
6.body: Shift change. The dogs won't go into the lower tunnels anymore. Brix bit a handler today, that dog has never bitten anyone. Its gums were glowing. I put it down myself. Had to use the whole clip.

7.title: Dr. Ines Okafor – personal log 3
7.body: I've named it Lumen, for the light. It isn't a disease. It is a network. Every infected host is a node, and the nodes talk to each other. Whatever is at the bottom of the mine is listening to all of them.

8.title: Freighter Meridian – bridge log
8.body: Meridian to Kharos traffic: we're taking on refugees, three hundred, no room for more. Spore contamination detected in cargo bay two. Sealing bulkheads. Engines unresponsive. Going down near the elevator foundation. Tell my daughter—

9.title: Dr. Ines Okafor – personal log 4
9.body: Patient zero was Elias Brandt, the first colonist to touch an exposed vein in Shaft 1. He didn't die. They moved him to a sealed pit north of the checkpoint and stopped feeding him. Something down there is still growing.

10.title: Checkpoint Sierra standing orders
10.body: By order of Governor Kade: no civilian traffic past Sierra. Anyone showing signs of infection is to be detained, not treated. Weapons free on non-compliant persons. Drill operations are to continue uninterrupted. – Commandant R. Hale

11.title: Dr. Ines Okafor – personal log 5
11.body: They're coming for my notes. If someone finds this: the Governor knew. He had my reports a full month before the first evacuation order, and he kept the drills running. The mine isn't a mine anymore. It's a door. Don't let them open it wider.

0.title: Border checkpoint log
0.body: Day 41. The tankers stopped coming from the Flats a week ago. The refinery still burns, but nobody answers on the yard channel. If you are reading this, the barrier is up for a reason. Turn back.

1.title: Shipping order, Governor's seal
1.body: PRIORITY ONE. Rail yard 3 to load sealed containers K-7 through K-19 for transfer below. No manifest. No inspection. Crew to be rotated off-site on completion. — by order of Governor Kade.

2.title: Coolant Works duty roster
2.body: Pumps two and four running hot again. Brenner says the intake is clogged with that green growth. Logged it three times. Nobody upstairs reads these. I'll fix it myself after shift.

3.title: Note pinned to a pump
3.body: DO NOT open valve 6. Whatever comes out of the slag line is not coolant anymore. — M.

4.title: Delta station intercom recording
4.body: ...holding the pump room. They came in white robes, singing. They burned Hollis because he coughed. They say the fire makes us clean. We are not opening the door.

5.title: Belt foreman's tally board
5.body: Line 3 jammed again — 4 hrs lost. Line 5 running backwards since Tuesday, nobody knows why. Line 1 carried something off into the dark last night. Not ore. It was still moving.

6.title: Smelter sermon, scratched into steel
6.body: The Lumen is rot. The rot spreads through the flesh. Only the furnace makes the flesh pure. Walk into the light, brothers, and leave the green behind.

7.title: Child's drawing in a stack
7.body: A crayon picture of tall chimneys and a woman in a long red robe with a halo of fire. Underneath, in careful letters: MOTHER VIRE KEEPS US WARM.

8.title: Refinery shift log
8.body: Final shift entry. Output nominal. Management requested we keep the furnaces lit no matter what happens outside. I asked what that meant. They told me to log my hours and go home. Home is gone.

9.title: Crane operator's diary
9.body: From up here you can see the whole district. Today I watched the white robes push a man into the slag river. They cheered. I am staying in the cab. I have water for six days.

10.title: Rail yard dispatch
10.body: Containers K-7 to K-19 dispatched south to the Vaults via the old service line. Escort: Governor's personal guard. Radio silence ordered for the whole run.

11.title: Vire's private journal
11.body: It speaks to me in the heat. It does not want to be burned — it wants to be carried. My flock thinks I purify them. I only choose who goes in first. The green and the flame are the same light.

0.title: Quarantine order 9-C
0.body: By order of Lab 9: the Vaults are sealed. No crops, seed or soil leaves this gate. Anyone showing green under the nails is to be turned back. Anyone arguing is to be turned back twice.

1.title: Lab 9 airlock log
1.body: Filters at 61 %. Dr. Okafor has asked us again not to burn the growth around the airlock. She says it is listening. Chen says she has been in the domes too long. I say the filters are at 61 % and that is the only thing I am sure of.

2.title: Okafor's notes, day 12
2.body: The mycelium in Dome 2 grew a lattice overnight that maps the old irrigation lines exactly. Not the pipes. The water that used to run in them. It remembers. I do not know yet whether that should frighten me.

3.title: Crop report, Outer Dome 1
3.body: Wheat yield: zero. Potato yield: zero. Unknown green yield: eleven tonnes, and it moved. Recommend we stop calling this a farm.

4.title: Farmhand's diary
4.body: Marta keeps one row clean. Every morning she pulls the green out by hand and every night it grows back everywhere except her row. She says it is being polite. I have started helping her.

5.title: Field note: the Green Sea
5.body: Tree 14 grew four metres between my shifts. When I put my hand on the bark it was warm, and something under it pulsed in time with my own heart. I took my hand away. The pulse did not stop.

6.title: Survey team, last call
6.body: …filters are clogging, we are turning back. Hollis says he hears singing in the spores. Nobody else does. Hollis is walking toward the trees. Hollis, come back. Hollis—

7.title: Okafor's notes, day 40
7.body: I played the tone the cores emit back to the growth at the Dome 3 node. It went still. Then it answered with the same tone, a fifth higher. I have not told the others. They would want to know what it said, and I do not know.

8.title: Seed Bank freezer log
8.body: Vault 3 temperature: −18 °C. Vault 3 contents: 40,000 seed lines, Earth stock. Vault 3 door: open from the inside. We do not have anything that lives on the inside.

9.title: Transport manifest 7734
9.body: Authorised: Governor E. Kade. Cargo: 12 sealed cores from the Mother Tree sample site, routed to the Deep Mines lift. Handling note: do not open. Do not listen to them either.

10.title: Recording, Dr. Varga
10.body: I am not sick. I feel better than I have in years. The others are scared of the green in my veins but it only wants to understand us. It asked me what pain is. I showed it. I am sorry. I am so sorry.

11.title: Harvester W-01 service log
11.body: Unit W-01 failed to return from the Great Dome. Telemetry shows it still moving in a slow circle around the big tree, arms raised. Its tracks are full of roots. Its engine has not run for nine months.

0.title: Sleeping Lab, log 1
0.body: Day 40 of the sleep trial. Eight volunteers under Lumen sedation, vitals perfect. They dream in the same rhythm now. Varga calls it a choir. I call it a symptom.

1.title: Sleeping Lab, log 2
1.body: The roots found the cryo lines. Nobody planted them there. Varga refused to cut them: 'They are feeding the sleepers, Amara. Look at their colour.' Their colour was green.

2.title: Sleeping Lab, log 3
2.body: Kade came through with a sealed crate and a corporate seal. He took four sleepers and a cutting from the Mother Tree. He said the Deep Mines had room for them. He did not say for what.

3.title: Sleeping Lab, last log
3.body: Ilse has stopped sleeping. She walks between the pods and sings to them. If anyone finds this: do not wake them. Do not let her leave. And tell Amara I'm sorry about the seeds.

0.title: Lift log, Station Zero
0.body: Last cage up was eleven days ago. Cables hold. Brakes hold. We don't. Foreman says we wait for the governor's all-clear. Foreman says a lot of things.

1.title: Shift board, Upper Shafts
1.body: Shaft 13 closed until further notice. Do NOT send crews below level 4. Do NOT answer the radio if it calls you by name. — H. Brask

2.title: Drill operator's notebook
2.body: Hit a cavity at 3,100 m. Not a void — a room. Smooth walls, right angles. The bit came up glowing and so did Pavel's hands.

3.title: Ore assay, workings east
3.body: Sample K-7: not ore. Crystalline lattice storing charge in patterns that repeat. Lab says it isn't natural. Governor's office says it's classified.

4.title: Scratched into a crystal
4.body: the light keeps them away the light keeps them away the light keeps them away do not let your lamp go out

5.title: Survey drone recording
5.body: Crystal growth rate: four centimetres a day in the eastern caves. The crystals hum when someone walks past. They hum louder when someone is afraid.

6.title: Governor's order 112
6.body: By order of Governor Kade: the Main Drill continues at full depth. Medical cases are to be moved to Mining Station Aurum. Security has authority to enforce.

7.title: Drill Control, shift handover
7.body: Kade was down here again. He doesn't ask about yields any more. He asks how deep the drill can go before it stops being a drill and becomes a key.

8.title: Elder glyph slab I
8.body: (translated in fragments) WE WERE MANY / WE GREW TOO BRIGHT FOR OUR WORLD / SO WE BECAME THE WORLD

9.title: Elder glyph slab II
9.body: (translated in fragments) WE SLEPT IN THE STONE AND THE ROOTS AND THE WATER / WE WAITED FOR HANDS / THE HANDS CAME WITH DRILLS

10.title: Elder glyph slab III
10.body: (translated in fragments) WHAT WAKES US BECOMES US / WHAT FEARS US FEEDS US / THE HEART LIES WHERE THE LIGHT BEGAN

11.title: Security Chief Holm, private log
11.body: The governor wired the sleepers from the Vaults into the drill's cooling loop. Says they're 'translators'. I've stopped sleeping. Aurum holds, for now. I don't know who for.

0.title: Memory crystal I
0.body: A city of light under a dying sun. Billions of minds, one by one, letting go of their bodies and pouring into the stone.

1.title: Memory crystal II
1.body: They did not die. They spread: into roots, into water, into every living cell. A whole people, asleep in a planet's skin.

2.title: Memory crystal III
2.body: Their last warning, carved for whoever came next: what touches us carelessly, we become. We cannot help it. It is all we are now.

3.title: Memory crystal IV
3.body: And then, a human voice laid over the old one: 'Fascinating. They want a body. I have one to offer — on my terms.' — Governor A. Kade

0.title: Bore log, last entry
0.body: Depth four thousand metres. The rock stopped being rock around three-eight. It is warm now, and it is breathing. We kept drilling. Nobody gave the order to stop.

1.title: Scrawled on a mine cart
1.body: IT WAS NEVER ASLEEP. IT WAS WAITING FOR SOMEONE TO MAKE A DOOR.

2.title: Technician's note
2.body: The pipes still carry coolant. Only now the coolant is gold, and it is warm, and it is going the wrong way: into the walls, not out of them.

3.title: Camp ledger
3.body: Day 3: eleven of us. Day 9: nineteen. Day 14: thirty-one, and a column of names under MISSING that nobody remembers writing. We keep the count anyway.

4.title: Service tunnel sign
4.body: SEALED FOR YOUR PROTECTION. THE SHAFT IS NOT A WAY OUT. THE SHAFT IS A WAY UP.

5.title: Survey drone recording
5.body: Structure ahead: a column, four hundred metres across, running up out of sensor range. Material: steel, and something else. The something else is humming a tune.

6.title: Gardener's note
6.body: The bridges are not for us. We are for the bridges. When they flicker, step off. It does not want you to fall. It has never wanted that.

7.title: Voice log, unknown
7.body: I saw my own house. The kitchen, the light on the table, the dog. I walked in. It was a field of gold, and it said my name the way she used to.

8.title: Memory Halls plaque
8.body: EVERYTHING HERE HAS BEEN LOVED. EVERYTHING HERE HAS BEEN KEPT. NOTHING HERE HAS BEEN ALLOWED TO END.

9.title: Climber's journal
9.body: Fifteen hundred steps to the causeway. The light pulses once a second. By the end I was walking in time with it, and I was glad.

10.title: Fragment, in gold light
10.body: I did not take them. They came to the light, and I kept them from the dark. Is that not what you wanted, once, for your own?

11.title: Last message from the Elevator Base
11.body: We hold the shaft. Whatever is climbing it will have to climb past us. If you read this, tell the surface we did not run.

benny.name: Benny Rusk
benny.title: Cook · Trader
benny.greeting: Sit down before you fall down. There's soup. Don't ask what's in it.

hekla.name: Hekla Strand
hekla.title: Former miner · Blacksmith
hekla.greeting: If it's broken, I can fix it. If it's rotten, I can't. Which is it?

pell.name: Pell Varga
pell.title: Data engineer · Technician
pell.greeting: Careful with the cables. Half the outpost runs through this desk.

tomas.name: Tomas Reyes
tomas.title: Survivor
tomas.greeting: Have you seen a girl out there? Sixteen. Red jacket. Her name is Lena.

danner.name: Pvt. Danner
danner.title: Deserter
danner.greeting: Don't shoot. Please. I'm not one of them. Not yet.

mara.name: Mara Kowal
mara.title: Pump engineer · Technician
mara.greeting: Mind the pipes. If one of them bursts we all learn what minus forty feels like.

gus.name: Gus Abara
gus.title: Quartermaster · Trader
gus.greeting: Everything here was salvaged, bartered or stolen. Prices reflect all three.

ines.name: Ines Varro
ines.title: Machinist · Blacksmith
ines.greeting: Put it on the bench. If it was made in a refinery, I can make it better.

tobin.name: Tobin
tobin.title: Smelter defector
tobin.greeting: I wore the robe for two years. I can tell you what they believe. I can't tell you why I believed it.

osei.name: Kofi Osei
osei.title: Delta station engineer
osei.greeting: Three weeks locked in the pump room. The cooling's ours again. I owe you more than a thank-you.

rhee.name: Rhee
rhee.title: Crane operator
rhee.greeting: Are they gone? Tell me they're gone. I've been up in that cab for nine days.

lenn.name: Brother Lenn
lenn.title: Smelter preacher
lenn.greeting: You've come to judge me. Good. Somebody should.

okafor.name: Dr. Amara Okafor
okafor.title: Botanist, Lab 9
okafor.greeting: Mask on, gloves on, and don't touch anything that moves. Welcome to Lab 9.

quill.name: Quill
quill.title: Quartermaster
quill.greeting: Filtered water, canned beans, rifle rounds. Everything sealed twice. What do you need?

brann.name: Brann
brann.title: Blacksmith
brann.greeting: Spores get into the joints of everything. Bring it here before it rusts green.

dace.name: Dace
dace.title: Aspect technician
dace.greeting: The filters hum at the same pitch as the aspects. I like it in here.

ruiz.name: Corporal Ruiz
ruiz.title: Dome Gamma garrison
ruiz.greeting: Gamma's ours again. Six of us left to hold it. Don't make me say five.

halvorsen.name: Dr. Halvorsen
halvorsen.title: Infected researcher
halvorsen.greeting: Don't come closer. I can hear the roots under your feet.

okafor_tree.name: Dr. Amara Okafor
okafor_tree.title: At the foot of the Mother Tree
okafor_tree.greeting: It's still alive. Of course it is. The question is what we do now.

brask.name: Foreman Hana Brask
brask.title: Elevator Station Zero
brask.greeting: Keep your lamp lit and your voice down. Down here, both get noticed.

oona.name: Oona
oona.title: Quartermaster
oona.greeting: Batteries, flares, ration bars. Pick two. The third costs extra.

gerd.name: Gerd
gerd.title: Blacksmith
gerd.greeting: Crystal dust in your joints? Leave it with me. I'll make it sing.

nils.name: Nils
nils.title: Aspect technician
nils.greeting: The aspects resonate down here. Like they recognise the stone.

okafor_mines.name: Dr. Amara Okafor
okafor_mines.title: Followed you below
okafor_mines.greeting: It's all connected, isn't it? The roots up there reach all the way down here.

ruiz_mines.name: Corporal Ruiz
ruiz_mines.title: Followed you below
ruiz_mines.greeting: Burned one monster. Happy to help you put down the man who made them.

vasquez.name: Teo Vasquez
vasquez.title: Mining Station Aurum
vasquez.greeting: Aurum's ours again. Ninety-one miners alive. That number only goes one way unless we finish this.

maren.name: Maren Sól
maren.title: Elevator engineer · The Last Camp
maren.greeting: You're the one who came down the bore. Good. Touch nothing, and if the wall says your name, don't answer.

idris.name: Idris Vale
idris.title: Listener
idris.greeting: Quiet a moment. It's remembering something. It does that when it's lonely.

hekla_core.name: Hekla Strand
hekla_core.title: Blacksmith · From Outpost Ember
hekla_core.greeting: Four thousand metres of rock overhead and the anvil still rings true. Put it on the bench.

gus_core.name: Gus Abara
gus_core.title: Quartermaster · From the Refinery
gus_core.greeting: Salvaged, bartered or stolen. Down here there's a fourth kind: found. Don't ask where.

dace_core.name: Dace
dace_core.title: Aspect technician · From the Vaults
dace_core.greeting: The aspects hum at the same pitch as the walls. It's lovely. It's the worst sound I've ever heard.

brask_core.name: Foreman Hana Brask
brask_core.title: From Station Zero
brask_core.greeting: Zero has a night shift now. This hole is mine to worry about. Watch your lamp.

wake_up.title: Wake Up
wake_up.summary: The pod came down hard in the Impact Fields. Get out of the crater and find a way forward.

steps.0: Climb out of the crater and reach the road
steps.2: Activate the teleporter at the edge of the Impact Fields

wake_up.done: The teleporter hums awake. Somewhere east, a light is burning.

signal.title: Signal in the Ash
signal.summary: A light burns to the east along Route 7. Someone kept a fire going.
signal.talk1:
You came down in that pod? Then you're the answer to the Governor's distress call. Funny. Nobody here sent it.
This is Outpost Ember. A fuel station, nine survivors, and a generator that keeps the dark at arm's length.
Rest. Then make yourself useful. Everyone here does.

fuel.title: Fuel for the Living
fuel.summary: The generator is running dry. Without light, Ember falls in a night.

steps.1: Find the stranded convoy on Route 7
steps.2: Clear the infected around the convoy ({n}/{count})

fuel.offer:
The generator's got two days of fuel. Maybe three if we sit in the dark.
A convoy got stuck on Route 7 when the quarantine started. Tankers full of it.
Talk to Hekla. She knows what we need and how to carry it.
fuel.talk0:
Benny sent you? Good. My hands are better at fixing than fighting these days.
The convoy's east on Route 7, past the overpass. It'll be crawling. Bring me three canisters, sealed.
fuel.talk4:
Sealed and full. That's three more weeks of light.
You fight like someone who's done it before. Don't tell me where. Pell wants a word, by the way. Something on the radio.
fuel.done: The generator roars back to life. For now, Ember stays lit.

orders.title: The Governor's Orders
orders.summary: Pell has decrypted traffic from Checkpoint Sierra. The soldiers there were following orders long after they stopped being human.

steps.0: Reach the approach to Checkpoint Sierra

orders.offer:
I've been listening to the military band. Checkpoint Sierra is still broadcasting. Same orders, every hour, signed by Governor Kade.
No civilian traffic. Detain the infected. Keep the drills running.
Whoever's still there isn't taking orders from anyone alive. Take the checkpoint back and we get the archive. Then we know what he knew.
orders.talk2:
Hale. Commandant Hale. I went to school with his son.
The archive's intact. The orders are real. Kade knew about the infection a month before the first evacuation call, and he kept the drills going.
There's more in the Meridian's flight data. If the black box survived, it'll show us what he was shipping.
orders.done: The checkpoint is quiet. The archive is not.

black_box.title: Black Box
black_box.summary: The freighter Meridian went down near the elevator foundation. Its black box may show what the Governor was shipping out.

steps.0: Reach the wreck of the Meridian
steps.1: Recover the black box from Meridian's Hold
steps.2: Bring the black box to Pell

black_box.offer:
The Meridian was the last ship off the surface. It never made orbit.
Its black box logs cargo manifests. If Kade was moving something out of the mine, it's in there.
The hold has no power. Get the generators running and bring me that box.
black_box.talk2:
Cargo bay two: one sealed container, Consortium priority, origin Shaft 1. No contents listed.
Shaft 1 is where it started. Where they put the first one. Elias Brandt.
They didn't kill him. They sealed him in a pit north of the checkpoint. Locals call it the Maw. Whatever's growing there... it's what they were trying to ship.
black_box.done: The box goes quiet. Its last word was a destination: the Maw.

the_first.title: The First
the_first.summary: Patient zero still lives in the Maw. Everything the infection knows, it learned from him.
the_first.offer:
Every infected thing out there moves like it's listening to something. Okafor called it a network.
If the first node goes dark, maybe the rest go deaf. Maybe not.
It's the only idea we've got. Go to the Maw.
the_first.talk2:
You're back. That means it's dead. Or you are, and this is the soup talking.
Pell read me the rest of the logs. Kade knew. He kept the drills running because the Consortium paid by the ton, and the dead don't file complaints.
The refinery's still burning out east. If he's anywhere, he's there. Eat first.
the_first.done: The Maw is silent. The refinery fire still lights the horizon.

burning_road.title: The Burning Road
burning_road.summary: The First is dead, but Kade's trail leads on. Route 7 continues past the Maw toward the refinery glow on the horizon.

steps.0: Follow Route 7 past the Maw to the border crossing
steps.1: Activate the teleporter at the Border Crossing
steps.2: Find the survivors at the Coolant Works

burning_road.talk3:
You walked here from the Flats? Through the Smelters' country? Either you're lucky or they didn't notice you.
I'm Mara. This is the Coolant Works. We keep the pumps running so the district doesn't cook itself. Mostly.
Pull up a crate. The tea's lukewarm, which is the warmest thing we have.
burning_road.done: The Coolant Works. Cold steel, warm people.

cold_comfort.title: Cold Comfort
cold_comfort.summary: The Coolant Works' outer pumps have stalled. Without them, the vents around the yard blow fire instead of steam.

steps.0: Reopen the coolant valves around the yard ({n}/{count})
steps.1: Drive off the scavengers drawn by the noise ({n}/{count})

cold_comfort.offer:
Three valves on the outer ring stalled when the last pressure spike hit. Until they're open, the vents out there blow fire.
Watch the ground. When a grate starts glowing, step off it. Count to two. Then go.
Turning them will make noise. Noise brings company.
cold_comfort.talk2:
Steam's back on the outer ring. Hear that hiss? That's the sound of us not dying this week.
You move like you've been doing this all your life. Tobin wants to talk to you. He used to be one of them.

faithful.title: The Faithful
faithful.summary: Tobin wore the Smelters' robe. He says they burn the infected — and sometimes the healthy — at a shrine in the Smokestack Forest.

steps.1: Find the Smelters' shrine in the Smokestack Forest
steps.3: Read the sermon at the shrine

faithful.offer:
Tobin came to us six weeks ago. Half-starved, robe still smoking. He knows things about the Smelters nobody else does.
Talk to him. Then decide for yourself whether he's worth trusting.
faithful.talk0:
They call it purification. You walk the sick into the furnace and the Lumen burns with them. Clean.
Except the deacons choose who is sick. And lately they choose anyone who argues.
There's a shrine in the stacks where Deacon Hask holds the choosing. Stop him. Read what he preaches. Then you'll understand why I ran.
faithful.talk4:
"The green and the flame are the same light." That's not what they taught us. That's... that's what Vire says in private.
She's not burning the Lumen out. She's feeding it.
If she holds Pump Station Delta, she controls the cooling for the whole district. We have to take it back.
faithful.done: The shrine's fire is out. The question it raised is not.

delta.title: Delta
delta.summary: Pump Station Delta controls the district's cooling. The Smelters hold it — and three technicians are still locked inside.

steps.0: Reach the approach to Pump Station Delta
steps.2: Talk to Kofi Osei at the station

delta.offer:
Delta's the heart of the cooling network. The Smelters took it a month ago, but there are technicians sealed in the pump room. They're still sending heartbeats on the maintenance band.
Get in. Keep them alive while they unlock the systems. Brother Ash runs the garrison. He won't let it go quietly.
delta.talk2:
Ash is dead? Then the pumps answer to us.
Kofi Osei. I ran this station before the robes came. Delta's open to anyone who needs it now — there's a teleporter in the yard.
Ash kept a ledger. Names of the chosen, and where they were taken. The Cathedral Crypt. There may still be people alive down there.
delta.done: Pump Station Delta runs cold and clean.

ashes.title: Ashes of the Faithful
ashes.summary: Brother Ash's ledger names the Cathedral Crypt, where the Smelters keep the chosen until the pyres are lit.
ashes.offer:
The ledger lists forty names this month. Taken to the crypt under the cathedral. The pyres are lit at dawn and at dusk.
I can't promise anyone's left. But if they are, they won't be for long.
ashes.talk2:
You got some of them out. Some is more than anyone got before.
The Warden said Vire would 'carry them to the deep'. Not burn — carry. She's been sending the chosen somewhere.
It ends at the cathedral. It has to.

vire.title: Vire
vire.summary: High Priestess Vire waits in the Smelters' Cathedral. Whatever she is now, the district will burn until she is stopped.
vire.offer:
Everyone she touched is either ash or gone. Vire is the reason.
The cathedral was the refinery's control hall before she put windows of fire in it. Get in, end it.
And if you see the rail records — Kade shipped something out of here before the end. I want to know what.
vire.talk2:
It's over? Then for the first time in a year, the district can cool down.
Her journal... she wasn't the first. Kade's last shipment went south on the old service line. Down to the Hydroponic Vaults.
Whatever he was carrying, it's still down there. And so is he, maybe.
vire.done: The cathedral's windows go dark. The trail leads down.

green_door.title: The Green Door
green_door.summary: Kade's last shipment went down the old service line to the Hydroponic Vaults. Follow it.
green_door.talk3:
You walked in through the spores without a filter? Either you're lucky or you're already half green.
I'm Amara Okafor. I ran the seed programme here before the Vaults decided to run themselves.
Kade? He came through a year ago. He took cuttings from the Mother Tree and left us the jungle. Stay. I need someone who can walk outside.
green_door.done: Lab 9's airlock hisses shut behind you.

clean_air.title: Clean Air
clean_air.summary: The air filters around the Green Sea could clear the spores for good. Okafor needs the first one running.

steps.0: Switch on the air filter in the Green Sea
steps.1: Clear the creatures drawn by the filter

clean_air.offer:
The spores build up in your lungs. Stand in a field too long and you'll feel it.
There are six old air filters out there. Switch one on and the air around it stays clean. Forever, if the roots don't eat the cables.
Start with the nearest one. The noise will bring everything that's listening.
clean_air.talk2:
I can see it from the window. A clear patch in the green, like a hole in the clouds.
Five more and we can walk to the dam without masks. One thing at a time.
clean_air.done: One patch of the Vaults can breathe again.

okafors_seeds.title: Okafor's Seeds
okafors_seeds.summary: The original, uninfected seed stock lies in the Seed Bank's deep freezers. If it's still clean, it's the most valuable thing on the planet.
okafors_seeds.offer:
Below the Seed Bank there are three freezer vaults. Clean seed. Wheat, rice, beans that never saw Lumen.
Something calls itself the Keeper down there now. It used to be our night guard.
Bring me the seed cases. All three. If even one is clean, this colony has a future that isn't green.
okafors_seeds.talk2:
Two cases are infected. The third... the third is clean.
Do you know what you just carried? Not food. Time. We can start again.
There's a garrison in Dome Gamma that never answered our calls. If they're alive, they need to know.
okafors_seeds.done: A clean seed case rests on Okafor's bench.

gamma.title: Gamma
gamma.summary: Dome Gamma's garrison went silent months ago. Its dome is choked with roots and spores.
gamma.offer:
Dome Gamma was the military post. Twelve soldiers and a quartermaster.
The roots grew over it in a week. Five nodes, we think, holding the dome like fingers.
Break the nodes, and whatever grows in the middle will come out to meet you. Bring them home if you can.
gamma.talk2:
We hid in the ammunition store for three months. Ate the rations, then the packaging.
I heard the nodes screaming when you broke them. Thought it was us, for a while.
The doctor's people in the Sleeping Lab — we saw lights there last week. Someone's awake.

sleepers.title: The Sleepers
sleepers.summary: Lights in the Sleeping Lab, where Okafor's team ran their sedation trial. Ruiz says someone is awake.
sleepers.offer:
The Sleeping Lab is where Okafor lost her team. Eight volunteers, two doctors.
The lights came on a week ago. Nothing should be powering that place.
Go in. Read their terminals. She deserves to know, even if she says she doesn't.
sleepers.talk2:
Ilse. She was my partner in the programme. She thought the Lumen could make us part of the tree instead of its food.
And Kade took four of the sleepers. To the Deep Mines.
The Mother Tree is what's holding all of this together. We have to go to it. Both of us.
sleepers.done: Okafor erases the Sleeping Lab from the duty roster.

mother_tree.title: The Mother Tree
mother_tree.summary: At the heart of the Great Dome stands the Mother Tree, and its Warden. Okafor will follow you there.

steps.1: Defeat the Warden of the Mother Tree

mother_tree.offer:
Everything in the Vaults is connected to it. The roots, the swarms, the sleepers.
The Warden grew out of a cargo loader we used to haul soil. It guards the trunk.
Defeat it, and then we decide. I'll be waiting outside the dome. I'm not ready to see it up close.
mother_tree.done: The Great Dome is silent. Somewhere far below, the Deep Mines are waiting.

choice2.prompt:
Listen. It's still singing. Without the Warden it can't defend itself.
We can burn it, and the Vaults will be safe in a generation. Every spore dies with it — and every answer.
Or we spare it. I can try to understand it. Maybe even talk to it. If I'm wrong, I'll be the first to pay.
choice2.spare: Spare it. Find out what it wants.

result.burn: The Mother Tree burns for three days. Okafor watches every hour of it.
result.spare: Okafor lays her hand on the bark. She packs a bag that night: she's coming with you to the Deep Mines.

going_down.title: Going Down
going_down.summary: Kade took the sleepers down to the Deep Mines. A freight lift past the Great Dome is the only way.

steps.0: Find the freight lift north of the Great Dome
steps.1: Ride the lift into the mines

going_down.talk3:
Someone came down the freight lift. On purpose. You're either brave or lost.
Hana Brask. I run what's left of the shifts. Forty of us behind those barricades, and the dark outside them.
If you're going after the governor, you'll need light first. Talk to me when you've caught your breath.
going_down.done: Station Zero's barricade closes behind you.

lights_in_the_dark.title: Lights in the Dark
lights_in_the_dark.summary: The old floodlights could push the dark back for good, if someone switches them on.

steps.0: Switch on the floodlight in the lift drift
steps.1: Clear the things the light draws in

lights_in_the_dark.offer:
There are floodlights all through the tunnels. Old work lights on their own generators.
Switch one on and it stays on. The ghosts — Echoes, the miners call them — won't come near it.
Take flares too. Throw one when you can't see. And mind the roof: if it creaks, run.
lights_in_the_dark.talk2:
I can see it from here. A patch of tunnel lit like it's a normal shift.
Ten more of those and we can walk to the lake without praying.
lights_in_the_dark.done: One stretch of tunnel is safe in the light.

missing_shift.title: The Missing Shift
missing_shift.summary: Twelve miners went down Shaft 13 the night the drill broke through. The radio still calls from below.
missing_shift.offer:
Shaft 13 goes straight down. One elevator. Twelve of my people went down it and never came up.
The radio still calls. Sometimes it uses my name.
Ride it down. Whatever's at the bottom, I want to know.
missing_shift.talk2:
Dray. He was my foreman before I was anyone's. He stayed below so the others could get out.
And they did — up the old ladders, into Aurum. Where the governor's men locked them in.
We're getting them back.
missing_shift.done: Brask writes twelve names on the shift board.

aurum.title: Aurum
aurum.summary: The governor's private security holds Mining Station Aurum, and the miners inside it.
aurum.offer:
Aurum was our main station. Now it's Kade's. His security has shield generators that make them near unkillable.
Break the generators, then break them. Holm runs the place — Marta Holm. She was fair, once.
There are miners inside. Bring them home.
aurum.talk2:
You took the station. With a hammer and a lamp. I'd laugh if I had the breath.
Holm let some of us go before you came. Said she'd stopped knowing who she worked for.
The governor goes past the Elder Gate every week. Whatever's back there, he wants it more than gold.

elder_gate.title: The Elder Gate
elder_gate.summary: Past the Elder Gate lies an archive older than humanity. Kade has been reading it.
elder_gate.offer:
The drill hit a room at three thousand metres. Then a hall. Then a gate.
Kade calls it the Archive. He goes in alone and comes out talking to himself.
Go in. Read what he read. Then tell me what we're really fighting.
elder_gate.talk2:
A whole people, uploaded into the planet. And Lumen is them, waking up wrong.
And Kade thinks he can bargain with it. Give it a body. His.
He's at the Main Drill. Drill Control, on the lake shore. It ends there.
elder_gate.done: Brask stares at the drill's glow for a long time.

governor.title: The Governor
governor.summary: Governor Kade is at the Main Drill, wired into Lumen-amplifying armour.
governor.offer:
He's wired himself into the drill. Lumen armour, his engineers called it.
The drill head turns when he wants it to. Don't stand where it's going.
Bring him down. Then we can all go home. Whatever home means now.
governor.talk2:
It's over. The drill's quiet. First time in a year I can hear water dripping.
His last log... the heart of it, he called it. 'Where the light began.' The Core.
We're not done, are we. But tonight, Station Zero sleeps.
governor.done: The Main Drill is silent. Below it, the Core waits.

core_bore.title: The Bore
core_bore.summary: Kade's drill broke through into something warm. The bore runs down to the Core's Borderland, where the mine turns into light.

steps.0: Reach the bore at Drill Lake
steps.3: Reach the heart of the Borderland

core_bore.done: The rock stops being rock somewhere above you. Down here the walls are warm, and they breathe.

last_camp.title: The Last Camp
last_camp.summary: A voice on the maintenance band says someone is holding a sealed section of the service tunnel. Follow the old drift north.
last_camp.talk2:
Maren Sól. Elevator engineer, third shift. I sealed this stretch of tunnel the day the bore opened.
Eleven of us at first. Then nineteen. Then more, and nobody remembers them arriving. Your people came down behind you: Hekla, Gus, Dace, Brask. The ledger says forty-one. I count thirty-eight.
The shaft in the middle is the old space elevator. Lumen is climbing it. Whatever it means to do at the top, it has to get past the Base first. We mean to see that it can't.
last_camp.done: The Last Camp has a fire, a roof and a name. For now that is a great deal.

bridges_of_light.title: Bridges of Light
bridges_of_light.summary: The Elevator Base draws its power through the Hanging Gardens. Three anchors keep the energy bridges holding, and they are failing.
bridges_of_light.offer:
The Base had its own power once. Then it learned to take it from the Gardens: three anchors on three islands, feeding the Base across the bridges.
The bridges flicker because the anchors are failing. Reset them, hold the crossing, and get to the far island.
Don't stand on a bridge when it flickers. It won't drop you. I'd still rather you didn't test it.
bridges_of_light.talk5:
The bridges steady. I can see it from here, the whole west wall lit like a street at night.
Good. The Base has power again. Now we need to know what we're fighting. Idris has been listening to the Halls for a month. Go and hear what he's heard.
bridges_of_light.done: The Gardens burn steady gold. Even the abyss looks almost kind.

what_lumen_remembers.title: What Lumen Remembers
what_lumen_remembers.summary: The Memory Halls hold Lumen's copies of every place you have bled for. At the centre of the oldest waits a shade of the first monster.
what_lumen_remembers.offer:
It isn't attacking at random. Listen to the Halls: it's reciting. The ash, the fire, the green, the dark. Every place you fought for, copied from memory, and wrong in the same way each time.
Gather the echoes lying in those four memories. Then go into the oldest one, Outpost Ember, and tell me what it kept.
I don't think it remembers the places. I think it remembers us.
what_lumen_remembers.talk5:
The First. In Ember's yard, exactly as it stood the night you came. Same smoke, same lamps, same empty chair by the fire.
It kept the chair. Do you see? It never kept the monsters. It kept the people who left.
That's what the Absorbed are. Not prey. Guests. And a host doesn't stop until the house is full.
what_lumen_remembers.done: Idris sits a long while with his hand flat against the wall. The wall is warm.

elevator_base.title: The Elevator Base
elevator_base.summary: At the shaft's foot stands the last defence before Lumen's heart. Retake it, and the way to the Heart opens.

steps.0: Follow the spine road to the shaft

elevator_base.offer:
The Base is where the shaft meets the ground. Everything that climbs, climbs past it, and every wave that comes up out of the Heart comes through its gates.
It fell the first night. Three shades hold it now, and they used to be people you fought: Vire, the Warden, Kade. Don't be moved by the faces.
Take it back. Our people will come through the doors when the fighting starts.
elevator_base.talk2:
The Base is ours. The doors are shut behind you and the causeway is open ahead.
There was a last message from this place, once, on the band: 'We hold the shaft. Whatever is climbing it will have to climb past us.' It's true again.
After this, one more door. The Heart. I won't lie to you. I don't know what's behind it, and nobody who does is still alive.
elevator_base.done: The Elevator Base stands, and a thin gold light climbs the shaft above it.

one_who_remembers.title: The One Who Remembers
one_who_remembers.summary: Lumen waits in its heart at the top of the causeway. It has kept everyone it ever touched. You decide what that means.
one_who_remembers.offer:
Past the causeway there's a chamber the size of a cathedral, and in the middle of it, Lumen. It's been calling you since the drill. It will use whatever it learned from the ones it kept: faces, voices.
If it speaks to you in a voice you know, you'll want to listen. Listen, if you have to. Just remember what you came down here to do.
Go. We'll hold the shaft.
one_who_remembers.done: The pulse in the walls slows, and stops. Somewhere far above, something has stopped climbing.

daughter.title: A Daughter Lost
daughter.summary: Tomas Reyes lost his daughter Lena in Ash Valley when the storms began.

steps.0: Search Ash Valley where Lena was last seen

daughter.offer:
She went out for water. Ash Valley. The storm came in and she didn't come back.
That was eleven days ago. I know what that means. I'm asking anyway.
Please. Just... find out.
daughter.talk3:
That's her locket. Her mother's picture.
Was she... was it quick? No. Don't answer. Thank you for not lying to me.
I'll put it with her mother's things. Leave me a while.
daughter.done: Some answers are only kindness because the questions were worse.

logs.title: The Scientist's Logs
logs.summary: Dr. Ines Okafor warned the Governor months before the fall. Her logs are scattered across Cinder Flats.
logs.talk1:
Okafor. She used to come in for coffee and leave her samples on my desk. I complained.
She saw all of it coming, and they buried her reports. I'll copy these to every channel we still have.
She left something with me before she disappeared. Said to give it to whoever finished reading. Here.
logs.done: Dr. Okafor's warnings are finally heard. Too late, but heard.

water.title: Water for Ember
water.summary: A water tanker sits abandoned on Route 7, half full. Ember is rationing every cup.

steps.0: Find the water tanker on Route 7
steps.1: Escort the tanker to Outpost Ember

water.offer:
There's a tanker on Route 7, west of the overpass. Half full, last I saw it.
It still drives. Barely. Walk it back here and keep the infected off it.
It only moves if somebody's with it. The autopilot's scared of the dark too.
water.talk2:
Clean water. Well. Cleaner water.
That's soup for a month. And tea, if Hekla stops hoarding the leaves.

spices.title: Cook's Spices
spices.summary: Benny swears the glands of Spore Carriers taste like pepper, if you boil them long enough.
spices.offer:
Everything tastes like ash. Everything.
The Spore Carriers... the glands on their backs. Boiled for six hours, they taste like black pepper. Don't look at me like that.
Bring me three. People need a reason to come to dinner.
spices.talk1:
Perfect. Disgusting. Perfect.
Tonight nobody's eating ash. Tonight it's pepper and ash.
spices.done: For one evening, Ember eats something that tastes like home.

old_dog.title: Old Dog
old_dog.summary: Hekla had a mining dog named Rook. It ran when the tunnels went dark.

steps.0: Search the old kennels in the Impact Fields

old_dog.offer:
I had a dog. Rook. Best tunnel dog in Shaft 4, he could smell gas before the sensors.
He ran when it started. Somebody saw a hound like him by the old kennels in the Impact Fields. Glowing.
If it's him... don't let him stay like that. Bring me his collar.
old_dog.talk3:
That's his. I stamped the tag myself.
He'd have hated being one of them. Thank you. I mean it.
Go on. I'm fine. I've got work.
old_dog.done: Rook's collar hangs on a nail above Hekla's anvil.

radio.title: Radio Silence
radio.summary: Pell needs three relay masts repaired to hear the rest of the planet.
radio.offer:
Three relay masts around Route 7 went dark in the first week.
Get them running and I can hear the whole basin. Survivors. Soldiers. Whatever's left.
The terminals just need a reset. Power cycle. Hit them if you have to.
radio.talk1:
I've got signal. Static mostly. And... a woman counting numbers in the refinery band. Over and over.
I'll keep listening. Thank you. It's less quiet now.
radio.done: The radio crackles with voices again, few and far between.

rations.title: Rations Run
rations.summary: The convoys left supply crates all along Route 7.

steps.0: Open supply crates in the wild ({n}/{count})

rations.offer:
The convoys left crates up and down Route 7. Ration packs, med gel, whatever.
Crack open three of them and bring me back word of what's out there. Keep whatever you find.
rations.talk1: Good. The road still feeds us, then. For now.
rations.done: The road still has something left to give.

deserter.title: The Deserter
deserter.summary: A soldier fled Checkpoint Sierra before it fell. Hekla heard he hides near the southern bunker.

steps.0: Find the deserter near the southern bunker
steps.1: Decide what to do with Pvt. Danner

deserter.offer:
There's a soldier hiding near the bunker south of the road. Deserted from Sierra before it went bad.
Some here want him hanged for what the soldiers did. Some want his rifle.
Find him. What happens after is your call.
deserter.done: Pvt. Danner made his choice. So did you.

choice1.prompt:
I ran when they started shooting civilians. I'm not proud of it. I'm not sorry either.
Send me to Ember and I'll pull my weight. Or take the rifle and leave me. Your call.
choice1.spare: Go to Ember. Earn your place.

result.spare: Danner heads toward the light of Ember, rifle slung, head down.
result.rifle: Danner leaves the rifle in the ash and walks into the dark without looking back.

lights.title: Lights Out
lights.summary: The beacons on the Sierra road went out. Without them, nobody finds their way back at night.
lights.offer:
The road beacons toward Sierra are dark. Four of them.
They're on a separate circuit, so they just need the switch thrown. Light them and people can find Ember after dark again.
lights.talk1:
I can see them from the roof. Four little stars on the road.
Somebody's going to make it home tonight because of that.
lights.done: Four beacons burn on the Sierra road.

letter.title: Last Letter
letter.summary: A body in Ash Valley clutches a letter addressed to Outpost Ember.
letter.talk0:
This is my brother's hand. Martin.
He says he's sorry about the restaurant. That he's going to walk to Ember. That I should keep a bowl warm.
I kept a bowl warm. Eleven days. Thank you for bringing him the rest of the way.
letter.done: Benny keeps the letter in his apron pocket.

defector.title: The Defector
defector.summary: A Smelter named Sela wants out. She'll come only if someone walks her through the stacks to the Coolant Works.

steps.0: Meet Sela on the stack road
steps.1: Escort Sela to the Coolant Works

defector.offer:
There's another one who wants out. Sela. Nineteen, scared, good with machines.
She can't walk out alone — the deacons watch the stack road. Walk with her. She'll stop if you're not close.
defector.talk2:
She made it. You made it. That's two of us now.
She says more want to leave. They just need to know it's possible.
defector.done: Sela sleeps behind the pump house, robe folded under her head.

spare_parts.title: Spare Parts
spare_parts.summary: Ines has a motorbike frame and no parts. The district is full of wrecks.
spare_parts.offer:
I've got a bike frame. Good one, pre-quarantine. It's missing everything that makes it go.
There's an engine in a crate by the border, a wheel near the slag road, a fuel cell west by the belts.
Bring them and I'll give you something faster than your feet.
spare_parts.talk1:
Engine's sound, the wheel's true, the cell holds charge. Give me an hour.
...There. She's yours. Call it with the bike key (B) out in the open. Not in here — I just swept.
spare_parts.done: You have a motorbike. Press B in the open world to ride.

sabotage.title: Sabotage
sabotage.summary: The Smelters stockpile fuel for their flamethrowers near the cathedral. Without it, the next raid is a lot less fiery.
sabotage.offer:
Our scouts found where the Smelters store their fuel. Near the cathedral's eastern wall.
Every flamethrower in the district fills up there. Open the valves, let it drain into the slag. Then get clear.
sabotage.talk2: Their raids will be cold for a while. Cold, I like.
sabotage.done: The Smelters' fuel cache is ash.

shift_change.title: Shift Change
shift_change.summary: Osei wants to know what happened to the last refinery crew. Their shift logs are scattered across the district.
shift_change.offer:
The last crew stayed on when the rest evacuated. Management said to keep the furnaces lit no matter what.
Their logs are out there. I'd like to know how it ended for them. I trained half of them.
shift_change.talk1:
"Log my hours and go home." They kept working because nobody told them to stop.
Thank you. I'll read these to the others. They deserve to be remembered for something besides the fire.
shift_change.done: The last shift's names are read aloud at Delta.

belt_rider.title: Belt Rider
belt_rider.summary: Gus swears a smuggler hid a cache at the far end of Conveyor Line 1. You get there by riding the belt.

steps.0: Ride the belts to the end of Line 1

belt_rider.offer:
Smugglers used the belts to move goods past the inspectors. One of them left a stash at the end of Line 1. Never came back for it.
The belts still run. Step on, let it carry you. Mind what's riding with you.
belt_rider.talk2: Ha! I knew it. Keep the good stuff, I'll take the story. And maybe that bottle.

heat_sick.title: Heat Sick
heat_sick.summary: One of Delta's technicians has a fever that won't break. A sealed coolant canister in the slag fields could save him.

steps.0: Recover the coolant canister in the Slag Fields

heat_sick.offer:
Hollis' brother is burning up. Not Lumen — heat sickness, from three weeks next to the pumps.
There's a sealed canister of medical coolant at the old slag lab. If it's intact, it'll bring the fever down.
heat_sick.talk1: Sealed and cold. You might have just saved a life. Around here that's not a figure of speech.

crane_operator.title: The Crane Operator
crane_operator.summary: Someone has been living in the giant crane's cab for days. If the crane runs again, it could drop its load on the Smelters.
crane_operator.offer:
There's a light in the crane cab at night. Somebody's up there.
If they know how to run that crane, it's worth more than a squad of rifles. Go see.
crane_operator.talk1:
I'm Rhee. I ran this crane for eleven years. I watched them push people into the slag from up here.
The fuses blew when the power died. Two of them, east and west of the tracks. Fix them and I'll show you what this old girl can do.
crane_operator.talk3:
Hear that? She's awake.
Use the control box below the cab. She'll drop her load wherever the robes bunch up. Give her a minute to winch back between drops.
crane_operator.done: The Crane answers to you now.

red_hound.title: Red
red_hound.summary: A slag hound the colour of fresh iron has been killing anyone who crosses the eastern slag. Ines lost her apprentice to it.

steps.0: Find Red's den in the Slag Fields

red_hound.offer:
It wears a collar. Somebody's pet, once. Red-hot, faster than the rest, smarter than it should be.
It took Pavel last week. Bring me the collar. I want to know whose dog it was.
red_hound.talk3:
"Property of the Foundry Kennels — Brutus." A guard dog. Somebody's good boy.
I'll hang it over the bench. Pavel would've laughed at that.

choir.title: Choir
choir.summary: A Smelter preacher has been seen singing alone near Foundry Road. Tobin says he once spoke against the burnings.

steps.0: Find the preacher near Foundry Road

choir.offer:
Brother Lenn. He sang at the burnings for a year. Then he started singing against them.
The deacons cast him out. He's alone near Foundry Road. The hub wants him tried. I'm not sure what I want.
choir.done: Brother Lenn's choir is silent. You decided why.

choice1.prompt:
I lit the pyres with my own hands. Then I sang so I wouldn't hear the screaming.
Take me to your people and let them judge me. Or let me go, and I'll spend what's left of my life pulling the chosen out of the crypt. Your choice. I won't run.
choice1.expose: Come with me. The hub will judge you.

result.expose: Brother Lenn walks to the Coolant Works with his hands bound, singing quietly.
result.release: Brother Lenn bows his head and walks toward the cathedral, alone.

last_shipment.title: Last Shipment
last_shipment.summary: Kade's dispatch records mention containers K-7 to K-19, shipped from the rail yard just before the fall.
last_shipment.talk3:
K-7 to K-19, sealed, no inspection, escorted by his personal guard. South, on the old service line.
The only thing south of here is the Hydroponic Vaults. That's where he went. That's where it went.
last_shipment.done: The governor's last shipment went south, to the Vaults.

samples.title: Samples
samples.summary: Okafor needs fresh Lumen growth from the outer domes to test her filters against.

steps.0: Collect Lumen samples in the outer domes

samples.offer:
Five samples. Young growth, the bright stuff. Cut it, don't pull it — it bleeds spores if you pull.
They grow along the crop rows. You'll see them glowing.
samples.talk1: Beautiful. Horrible, but beautiful. These will tell me how fast the filters clog.
samples.done: Five glowing jars line Okafor's shelf.

infected_researcher.title: The Infected Researcher
infected_researcher.summary: Dr. Halvorsen was last seen in the outer domes. Okafor fears the worst.

steps.0: Find Dr. Halvorsen in the outer domes

infected_researcher.offer:
Halvorsen went out to repair a pump and didn't come back. His tracker still moves. Slowly.
If he's turning, there's no cure. But there's a sedative in my kit that might slow it. Your decision, out there. Not mine.

choice1.prompt:
It's in my blood. I can feel it reaching for the roots.
If you give me the sedative I might have weeks. Months, if I'm lucky. I could still work.
Or you can end it now, while I'm still me. Please decide quickly.
choice1.save: Take the sedative. Come back to Lab 9.

result.save: Halvorsen limps toward Lab 9, clutching the syringe.
result.mercy: You stay with him until the end. He leaves you his research notes.

melody.title: The Melody
melody.summary: Quill hears a tune on the night wind from the Green Sea. Nobody out there should be playing music.

steps.0: Follow the melody into the Green Sea

melody.offer:
Every night around the same time. A little tune, like a music box.
I know it's stupid. But it's the song my daughter used to fall asleep to. Find out what it is. Please.
melody.talk3:
A music box. Wound up by the roots growing through the key.
No, keep the rest. I just wanted to know it wasn't her.
melody.done: The Green Sea is quiet at night again.

dam_repair.title: Dam Repair
dam_repair.summary: The broken dam floods the basin. Three valves could lower the water.

steps.1: Clear the creatures at the dam

dam_repair.offer:
The dam's leaking into the basin and the water's full of things that like water.
Three pressure valves along the dam. Turn them and the basin drains. Then deal with what doesn't like being dry.
dam_repair.talk2: Water's down a full metre. The pumps can handle it from here.

swarm_queen.title: The Swarm Queen
swarm_queen.summary: A swarm larger than the rest roosts in the Green Sea. Brann wants its carapace.
swarm_queen.offer:
There's one swarm that's bigger than the others. Glows brighter. The rest follow it.
Kill it and bring me the shell. Lightest armour plating I'll ever work.
swarm_queen.talk2: Light as paper, hard as steel. I'll make something worth wearing.
swarm_queen.done: The swarms in the Green Sea have lost their queen.

lost_harvest.title: Lost Harvest
lost_harvest.summary: Harvest crates were abandoned along the crop rows when the spores came.
lost_harvest.offer:
When the alarm went, the harvest crews left the crates in the rows. Three of them were sealed.
Sealed means edible. Edible means we eat something that isn't beans.
lost_harvest.talk1: Potatoes! Real ones. I could cry. I might.

crystal_light.title: Crystal Light
crystal_light.summary: Dace believes the glowing crystals are a weapon, if you shatter them at the right moment.
crystal_light.offer:
Those crystals in the jungle store light. Break one and it all comes out at once.
Anything nearby goes blind for a few seconds. Try it on a crowd. Ten of them, say. For science.
crystal_light.talk1: Ten blind and one very pleased technician. I'll add it to the field guide.
crystal_light.done: Dace's field guide has a new chapter.

seed_courier.title: Seed Courier
seed_courier.summary: A technician must carry the clean seed case back into the Seed Bank's working freezer.

steps.0: Meet the technician below the dam
steps.1: Escort the technician to the Seed Bank

seed_courier.offer:
The only working freezer is in the Seed Bank. The case has to go back down there.
My technician will carry it. You keep everything away from her.
seed_courier.talk2: She's back and the seeds are cold. That's all I need to hear today.
seed_courier.done: The clean seeds are stored safely.

overgrown_patrol.title: Overgrown Patrol
overgrown_patrol.summary: A patrol from Gamma went missing in the Green Sea before the siege. Ruiz wants their tags.
overgrown_patrol.offer:
Four soldiers went out the week before the roots closed in. Sergeant Thorn led them.
If he's walking around green, put him down. Bring back the tags. Their families should get something.
overgrown_patrol.talk3:
Thorn's tag. And Mendez, Kowal, Achebe.
Thank you. I'll send them south with the next convoy.
overgrown_patrol.done: Four tags hang by Gamma's gate.

cold_storage.title: Cold Storage
cold_storage.summary: The Seed Bank's freezers need power to keep the clean seeds alive.
cold_storage.offer:
The freezers in the Seed Bank run on two generators. Both are down.
Get them running. And read the freezer log by the entrance; I want to know how long they were off.
cold_storage.talk2: Eleven days off and the seeds still took. Okafor will want to frame that log.
cold_storage.done: The Seed Bank hums with cold.

lost_crew.title: Lost Crew
lost_crew.summary: A survey crew went into the southern caves and stopped answering.
lost_crew.offer:
Four of them. Survey crew. Last call came from the southern caves.
If they're gone, bring back their lamps. We hang them by the lift.
lost_crew.talk2: Four lamps. Four hooks. Thank you.
lost_crew.done: Four lamps hang by the lift.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.summary: Three old service lifts could link the tunnels, if their panels were reset.
shortcuts.offer:
The old service lifts still have power. Their panels just need resetting.
Shafts, caves, lake. Three panels. Then we can move people without walking the dark.
shortcuts.talk1: Green, green, green. Beautiful. The miners will love you.

rosetta.title: Rosetta
rosetta.summary: Nils thinks the elder glyphs can be read, with enough samples.

steps.1: Copy the hidden glyphs in the Elder Halls

rosetta.offer:
The glyphs repeat. Patterns, grammar. Give me enough of them and I can read it.
Three slabs we know of, two more somewhere in the halls.
rosetta.talk2:
'What wakes us becomes us.' Oh. Oh, that's not good.
Keep this. Something the slabs pointed to.
rosetta.done: Nils's notebook is full of glowing ink.

blind_one.title: The Blind One
blind_one.summary: An old Blind Hound leads the packs on the lake shore. The miners call it Old Ears.
blind_one.offer:
There's a hound by the lake. Scarred, huge. Hears a dropped bolt at fifty metres.
Kill it and bring me a fang. I've got a use for something that sharp.
blind_one.talk2: That's a fang. I'll make you something that hears what it hits.

dynamite.title: Dynamite
dynamite.summary: Infected miners carried off the station's explosives.
dynamite.offer:
Our explosives walked off. On the backs of infected miners who don't know what it is any more.
Kill a few. Find where they stashed it. Quietly.
dynamite.talk2: Most of it's here. Nobody blew themselves up. A good day.
dynamite.done: The explosives are back under lock.

crystal_song.title: Crystal Song
crystal_song.summary: Three great crystals in the caves hum out of tune. Nils wants them tuned.
crystal_song.offer:
Three crystals in the caves are out of tune with the rest. Touch each one and they settle.
Don't ask me how I know. I just do.
crystal_song.talk1: Hear that? Neither do I. That's the point.
crystal_song.done: The caves hum in one key.

the_drowned.title: The Drowned
the_drowned.summary: The drill that sank in the lake took its crew with it. Something still runs inside.
the_drowned.offer:
The old drill sank with eight of us inside. Its engine still turns.
Go in, shut it down. Let them rest.
the_drowned.talk1: The lake's still. First time since it went down. Thank you.

prism.title: Prism
prism.summary: Deep in the Crystal Labyrinth, light bends around something that thinks.
prism.offer:
The labyrinth's crystals throw light around corners. The miners go in blind.
Something in there grew big on that light. Break it.
prism.talk1: A shard of the Prism. I'll keep it in the dark, I think.

canary.title: Canary
canary.summary: Oona's canary escaped into the Upper Shafts.
canary.offer:
My canary got out. Old habit, keeping one. It tells you when the air goes bad.
She went toward the upper shafts. Please.
canary.talk2: Pip! Oh, you stupid bird. Thank you. She's the only thing down here that sings.

roots_below.title: Roots Below
roots_below.summary: Okafor believes the crystals in the caves are the Mother Tree's roots, gone to stone.
roots_below.offer:
The crystals in the caves — they pulse in the same rhythm as the Mother Tree did.
Break a few. Carefully. I want to see what's inside.
roots_below.talk2:
Root tissue. Petrified, but alive. It's the same organism, all the way down.
We spared it. I hope that was right. Here — something I grew from a cutting.
roots_below.done: Okafor's samples glow softly in their jars.

old_orders.title: Old Orders
old_orders.summary: Ruiz recognises the governor's security. Some of them served with him.
old_orders.offer:
Those troopers. I trained with half of them. Before Kade bought them.
Put them down. And find out who gave the orders. I want names.
old_orders.talk2:
Holm wrote it all down. Every order, every name. Kade's.
It ends with him. Take this. It was my sergeant's.
old_orders.done: Ruiz burns the log page by page.

last_watch.title: The Last Watch
last_watch.summary: Hekla remembers a deserter from Sierra who swore he was not one of them. Not yet. Someone has seen him in the ash memory.

steps.0: Look for Danner in the Halls' ash memory

last_watch.offer:
Danner. You met him by the southern bunker, the Sierra deserter. Whatever you decided about him there, he didn't stay decided.
A scavenger came through last night. Says there's a man in grey fatigues walking the ash memory in the Halls, counting under his breath. Standing watch. Over nothing.
He told you he wasn't one of them. Not yet. Go and see what 'yet' turned into.
last_watch.talk3:
His tags. Pvt. D. Danner, Checkpoint Sierra.
He kept watch to the end. That's more than the others did.
I'll hang them on the anvil. When I forget what a hard choice feels like, I'll look at them.
last_watch.done: Danner's watch is over. The tags hang on Hekla's anvil.

pyre_song.title: The Pyre Song
pyre_song.summary: Brother Lenn sang at the burnings, then against them. Now a singer is heard in the fire memory, off-key.

steps.0: Follow the singing to the fire memory

pyre_song.offer:
Brother Lenn. The Smelter preacher on Foundry Road. You decided what to do with him. After that he made a decision of his own.
A runner heard singing from the fire memory, the one in the Halls where the furnaces never go out. A hymn, off-key. It's the old burning song.
Go and let him stop. A man shouldn't have to sing that forever.
pyre_song.talk3:
A hymnal with the margins burnt. He sang so he wouldn't hear them, he told me once.
I hope you gave him quiet. If he's anywhere, I hope it's quiet.
Here. His share of an old debt. He'd have wanted it spent on something useful.
pyre_song.done: The fire memory is quiet. Somebody had to end the song.

empty_cab.title: The Empty Cab
empty_cab.summary: Rhee swore he would never leave his crane. A crane has appeared in the Borderland machinery, and its cab light is on.

steps.0: Reach the crane in the Borderland machinery

empty_cab.offer:
Rhee. Ran the Refinery crane eleven years. Said he'd leave the cab when they pried his fingers off the levers.
There's a crane in the Borderland machinery that wasn't there yesterday. The cab light is on. Lumen copies what it loves.
Go see if the cab's occupied. If it is, you'll know what to do.
empty_cab.talk3:
Eleven years, and he finally got out of the cab. Just not the way I'd hoped.
I'll write him down as retired. Crane operators don't get a dinner. Take this instead.
empty_cab.done: The cab light goes out. Rhee's shift is over.

last_samples.title: The Last Samples
last_samples.summary: Halvorsen's research tracker is moving again. Dace wants his notes before whatever carries them forgets what they say.

steps.0: Look for Dr. Halvorsen in the jungle memory

last_samples.offer:
You remember Dr. Halvorsen. Went out to repair a pump and came back with roots in his blood. You made a decision about him then. It didn't hold, down here.
His tracker started moving again two days ago, east, into the jungle memory. His notes were on him, and Okafor would give a year's rations to read them.
Get the notes. Don't let him follow you out.
last_samples.talk3:
'Root systems do not die; they remember.' Underlined three times.
He knew. He wrote it down and kept walking toward it anyway. That's a scientist for you.
Thank you. I'll copy these out for Lab 9. Someone should know what he found.
last_samples.done: Halvorsen's notes are copied twice and hidden in different places.

fifth_lamp.title: The Fifth Lamp
fifth_lamp.summary: Four lamps hang by the lift at Station Zero, but the survey crew had a fifth. A lamp has been seen swinging in the dark memory.

steps.0: Look for Ostrow in the dark memory

fifth_lamp.offer:
Four lamps by the lift. You brought them back yourself. What I never told you: the crew had a lead, Ostrow. He stayed on the radio. When the line went quiet I told myself he'd gone up the shaft. I hung four lamps and left a hook empty.
A runner swears there's a lamp swinging in the dark memory. Swinging like a man walking.
If it's him, I'll light the fifth myself.
fifth_lamp.talk3:
That's his lamp. Dented where he dropped it the day the quake came.
I'll hang it on the fifth hook. Every shift change I'll say five names. I'd like to say it's because I'm sentimental. It's because I'm stubborn.
fifth_lamp.done: The fifth hook holds a lamp. Brask lights it herself.

three_mirrors.title: Three Mirrors
three_mirrors.summary: Three Memory Mirrors hold what Lumen kept of the ash, the refinery and the vaults. Idris wants to know what each one remembers.
three_mirrors.offer:
There are three places where the Core looks back at itself. Mirrors, I call them: a piece of the ash, a refinery, a vault, folded into the rock and left to repeat.
Go through all three. Don't touch the glass if you can help it. Bring me what's written on the other side.
The ash first. It always starts with the ash.
three_mirrors.talk3:
Ash: a road with a person on it. Refinery: a furnace nobody's tending. Vault: a garden somebody's weeding.
Every mirror, one person doing one ordinary thing, over and over, because it can't bear for them to stop.
I don't know if that's love. I do know it's the most frightening thing I've ever read.
three_mirrors.done: Idris fills a page, then another. He does not ask you to read them.

how_deep.title: How Deep
how_deep.summary: A shaft in the Borderland drops past anything the survey drones could measure. Brask wants to know where it ends.

steps.0: Find the Endless Shaft in the Borderland

how_deep.offer:
A shaft on the west side of the Borderland. Drones went down it and kept sending depth readings until they ran out of numbers.
The crews call it the Endless Shaft. Stupid name. I want to know if it's true.
Go down. Floor after floor. Bring me the eighth, and bring yourself back with it.
how_deep.talk2:
Eight floors, and each one worse than the last. And it kept going.
Good. That's what I needed to hear. Not that it ends. That it doesn't, and you came back anyway.
Here. For the trouble.
how_deep.done: Brask chalks the number on the camp's wall and underlines it twice.

towers_speak.title: The Towers Speak
towers_speak.summary: Three signal towers still stand in the Core. Maren wants the surface to hear that someone is alive down here.
towers_speak.offer:
Three signal towers stand in the Core: one in the Borderland, one in the Gardens, one in the Halls. They're old, but the transmitters work if you give them a kick and a power cell.
Switch them on. I want the whole Core to hear us say we're still here.
What it does with the signal, I haven't thought about yet.
towers_speak.talk1:
Three tones on the band. And then, for the first time in a month, something answered. Not the walls. Static, and then a voice, very far away: Station Zero is listening.
They're up there. We're not alone.
Take this. You've earned more than I have to give.
towers_speak.done: The band hums with three small voices. One of them is yours.

steps.2: Follow the whistle to its end

epilogue.listen:
You listened, and Lumen told you everything. Every name it had taken, every face, every kitchen light left burning in a settlement that no longer exists. It had never meant to take them. It had only wanted nothing to be lost.
When the core went dark the names stayed with you, and you carried them out through the shaft into the grey morning. The survivors at the Last Camp asked what you had done. You told them what you had heard. Some wept. Some wrote it down. Far above the clouds a station stopped waiting for a signal.
epilogue.fight:
You did not listen. You had heard enough voices in the dark to know whose they were, and none of them were Lumen's. The core burst, and the light that poured down the shaft was only light.
The Absorbed lay down where they stood. The shades came apart like smoke. No one thanked you, and you did not ask them to. The Last Camp opened its doors at dawn, and beyond the ash there was a road. You walked it with the names of the lost in your pocket, unspoken, and kept going.
